utility.notes: SCE's own 'Incorporated Cities and Counties Served by SCE' fact sheet (updated 3/17/2025) explicitly lists 'Menifee' by name among the cities in its service area, and the city's own page directs applicants to contact SCE directly for utility work.

generation_supplier.notes: Menifee is not a Western Community Energy member city (Eastvale, Hemet, Jurupa Valley, Norco, Perris, and Wildomar are); WCE itself deregistered with the CPUC and dissolved via Chapter 9 bankruptcy in 2021. No CCA was found serving Menifee this session.

value.name: California SGIP - current category and budget check required
value.description: New applications and waitlist applications for ratepayer-funded SGIP budgets closed on December 30, 2025. New AB 209 applications have a June 30, 2028 deadline. The 2026 SGIP rate table publishes $3.10/W for solar and $1.10/Wh for storage in applicable Residential Solar and Storage Equity categories. Household eligibility and live budget availability vary by category and program administrator; check the official Program Metrics tracker before relying on an incentive.
value.eligibility: Eligibility varies by 2026 SGIP budget category, program administrator, property, income/pathway, project rules, and live funding availability.

battery_programs.notes: SGIP program data refreshed on 2026-08-26 from the official 2026 Handbook and live Program Metrics. Earlier locality records contained 2025 opening/availability language. This record does not assert household eligibility, reservation availability, or a guaranteed incentive; current category and program-administrator status must be checked before reliance.

value: Schedule the inspection via the Menifee Permit Portal (registration required) after the permit is issued
Inspections are conducted Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.; requests made before 2:00 p.m. can be performed the next business day
For SolarAPP+ permits, the solar representative must verify the Inspection Checklist and sign it confirming completion prior to inspection
Two inspections per solar company can be accommodated per day

value.notes: The city states a plan check wait time of up to 14 business days for all solar submittals, with resubmittal turnaround matching that same standard.

value.program_or_pathway: Standard solar PV permitting (Menifee Permit Portal)
other_conditions: All solar PV systems require an electrical permit
Additional permits required if structural modifications are necessary (e.g., new struts, purlins, or framing members)
Submittals must comply with the 2025 California Building Standards Code

permit_fees.notes: The city's page references 'low permit fees' for solar PV installations but does not state a specific amount.
